in [[Poisoned Outcrops]] }} {{otheruses|the charmable animal|the collector during Farewell to Gaile|Hyena (collector)}} The [[Hyena]] is a [[charmable animal]] found in [[the Desolation]]. They are very communicative, having dozens of vocalizations, with only a couple sounding like laughter. [[Elona|Elonian]] myth says that Hyenas were watching [[Abaddon]]'s imprisonment and that they continue to laugh at him today. ==Locations== *[[Core]] **[[The Battle Isles]] ***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress) *[[Nightfall]] **[[The Desolation]] ***{{NPC location|Crystal Overlook}} (at the [[the Alkali Pan]] exit) ***{{NPC location|Poisoned Outcrops}} (outside the [[Lair of the Forgotten]], near the undead groups on the left) ***{{NPC location|The Alkali Pan}} ***{{NPC location|The Ruptured Heart}} == Notes == *[[Elder Hyena]]s found in the wild cannot be charmed. *Hyenas deal [[slashing damage]]. *[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Elona)'' {{Charmable animal nav}}
